legs.label: Compute the library inventory
legs.description: Deterministic pre-computation: every card path, altLabels, and the backlink map, in one pass.
legs.lead: The machine hands the surveyor the graph so the surveyor spends its time on judgment.

legs.label: Survey the Source into a delta manifest
legs.description: Read the ruled Source, trace its blast radius through the library graph, and write the ordered change plan.
legs.lead: Backstage maps every change the Source earns — and nothing it doesn't.
beats: Reads the Source in full and extracts every instruction the library must absorb, quoting the lines that earn each change.
Finds every named card and greps the whole library for inbound ripples — a rename that misses one link breaks the graph.
Orders the changes so content always has a home, and routes judgment calls to the director instead of guessing.

legs.label: Validate the manifest
legs.description: Deterministic check: manifest shape, change kinds, and card paths against the library on disk.
legs.lead: The machine rejects a malformed plan before the director ever sees it.

legs.label: Rule on the delta manifest
legs.description: The director reads the plan in product language and approves it, or says what to change.
legs.lead: The director rules on the plan, not the diff.
beats: Raven puts the delta plan and its open questions in front of the director.
He approves, or reacts — rulings on open questions, cuts, additions.
Approval releases the builder; any reaction loops back to a revise pass.

legs.label: Fold the director's ruling into the manifest
legs.description: Rewrite the manifest whole to fold in the director's gate reaction; his words win and are recorded as evidence.
legs.lead: Backstage folds the ruling in and the validator runs again.

legs.label: Execute the manifest against the library
legs.description: Apply the approved changes in order — create before retire, every inbound link updated, ledger events through ax.
legs.lead: The builder applies the plan exactly; nothing is deleted before its replacement exists.
beats: Applies each change in manifest order — renames refit prose, absorbs move content before deleting donors.
Updates every inbound link by searching the library, not by trusting the plan.
Writes an execution report where every change id is accounted for — done or deviation, never silence.

legs.label: Deterministic library checks
legs.description: Deterministic check: the catalog loads clean, no dangling links, and the manifest's changes are actually on disk.
legs.lead: Findings from a failed check route straight back to the builder.

legs.label: Teach back the changed library
legs.description: Fresh-eyes restatement of what each changed card now means, audited against the Source for holes.
legs.lead: The catch for the card that reads well but means something subtly different.
beats: Re-reads every changed card from disk and states its meaning in its own words — not the manifest's.
Audits the Source's demands against what landed; names any hole plainly.
Surfaces every deviation and noticed-but-untouched item for the director to triage.

legs.label: Confirm the teach-back
legs.description: The director confirms the cards mean what he meant, or sends a correction back to the builder.
legs.lead: The director's confirmation is what closes the Source.
